examples.en: She made a vow to never lie again.
examples.zh: 她立下誓言，再也不撒谎。

examples.en: We have three exams at the end of this semester.
examples.zh: 这个学期末我们有三场考试。

examples.en: The surgeon worked with great precision.
examples.zh: 外科医生以极高的精确度进行手术。

examples.en: Mom is cooking dinner downstairs.
examples.zh: 妈妈正在楼下做晚饭。

examples.en: The metal bar is rigid and will not bend.
examples.zh: 这根金属棒很坚硬，不会弯曲。

examples.en: I like strawberry jam on my toast.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在吐司上抹草莓果酱。

examples.en: I miss the quiet streets of my hometown.
examples.zh: 我想念家乡那些安静的街道。

examples.en: The gymnast did a perfect tumble across the mat.
examples.zh: 那位体操运动员在垫子上完成了一个完美的翻滚。

examples.en: After getting a job, she became financially independent.
examples.zh: 找到工作后，她在经济上独立了。

examples.en: Statistically, this medicine helps most patients.
examples.zh: 从统计上看，这种药对大多数病人有帮助。

examples.en: Always keep a backup of your important files.
examples.zh: 一定要为你的重要文件保留一个备份。

examples.en: The smoke detector went off during the night.
examples.zh: 烟雾探测器在夜里响了起来。

examples.en: He received psychiatric care at the hospital.
examples.zh: 他在医院接受了精神病方面的治疗。

examples.en: The city streets form a neat grid.
examples.zh: 这座城市的街道构成了整齐的网格。

examples.en: You can vote when you turn eighteen.
examples.zh: 满十八岁你就可以投票了。

examples.en: The workers rotate between the day and night shifts.
examples.zh: 工人们在白班和夜班之间轮换。

examples.en: The candidates asked for a recount of the votes.
examples.zh: 候选人要求重新计票。

examples.en: The singer stood alone in the bright spotlight.
examples.zh: 歌手独自站在明亮的聚光灯下。

examples.en: The early settlers built their homes near the river.
examples.zh: 早期的移民在河边建造了他们的家园。

examples.en: She is always polite to her neighbors.
examples.zh: 她对邻居总是很有礼貌。

examples.en: We enjoyed a magnificent view from the mountain top.
examples.zh: 我们从山顶欣赏到了壮丽的景色。

examples.en: The chair made a loud scrape across the floor.
examples.zh: 椅子在地板上发出刺耳的刮擦声。

examples.en: On the contrary, I think the plan will work.
examples.zh: 恰恰相反，我认为这个计划会成功。

examples.en: The superintendent fixed the broken heater in our building.
examples.zh: 大楼的管理员修好了我们楼里坏掉的暖气。

examples.en: The microscope uses optical lenses to enlarge images.
examples.zh: 显微镜利用光学镜片来放大图像。

examples.en: My little brother is fourteen years old.
examples.zh: 我弟弟十四岁了。

examples.en: An ambulance rushed the patient to the hospital.
examples.zh: 一辆救护车把病人飞快地送往医院。

examples.en: The eagle searched the field for its prey.
examples.zh: 老鹰在田野上搜寻它的猎物。

examples.en: The company hired experts to do a yearly audit.
examples.zh: 公司聘请专家进行年度审计。

examples.en: He got a small bump on his head from the door.
examples.zh: 他被门撞到，头上起了个小肿块。

examples.en: There was a peculiar smell in the old house.
examples.zh: 那座老房子里有一股奇怪的气味。

examples.en: Her eyes were full of sadness when she said goodbye.
examples.zh: 她告别时眼里满是悲伤。

examples.en: The students were enthusiastic about the school trip.
examples.zh: 学生们对这次学校旅行非常热心。

examples.en: The baby cried continually all through the night.
examples.zh: 宝宝整夜不停地哭。

examples.en: The brave firefighter carried the child to safety.
examples.zh: 勇敢的消防员把孩子抱到了安全的地方。

examples.en: Each applicant must fill out this form.
examples.zh: 每位申请人都必须填写这份表格。

examples.en: We had a light supper before going to bed.
examples.zh: 睡觉前我们吃了一顿简单的晚餐。

examples.en: Three students were absent from class today.
examples.zh: 今天有三名学生缺课。

examples.en: Please restart the modem if the internet stops working.
examples.zh: 如果网络不通了，请重启调制解调器。

examples.en: The rescue boat was their only salvation.
examples.zh: 那艘救生船是他们唯一的救命稻草。

examples.en: The design is still at a conceptual stage.
examples.zh: 这个设计还处于概念阶段。

examples.en: We made a small modification to the plan.
examples.zh: 我们对计划做了一点小修改。

examples.en: Only one student passed, namely Tom.
examples.zh: 只有一名学生通过了，就是汤姆。

examples.en: You need a visa to enter that country.
examples.zh: 进入那个国家你需要一张签证。

examples.en: I need to renew my library card next week.
examples.zh: 下周我需要续办我的借书证。

examples.en: A plane flew overhead while we waited.
examples.zh: 我们等候时，一架飞机从头顶飞过。

examples.en: A wild goose landed on the calm lake.
examples.zh: 一只野鹅落在平静的湖面上。

examples.en: We sat by the warm fireplace and told stories.
examples.zh: 我们坐在温暖的壁炉旁讲故事。

examples.en: This peach is sweet and juicy.
examples.zh: 这个桃子又甜又多汁。

examples.en: Please summarize the article in a few sentences.
examples.zh: 请用几句话概括这篇文章。

examples.en: Good teachers nurture their students' talents.
examples.zh: 好老师会培养学生的才能。

examples.en: Loud thunder can frighten small children.
examples.zh: 巨大的雷声会吓到小孩子。

examples.en: The new bridge was formally opened yesterday.
examples.zh: 这座新桥昨天正式开通了。

examples.en: She has vivid memories of her childhood.
examples.zh: 她对童年有着鲜明生动的记忆。

examples.en: He types quickly on his computer keyboard.
examples.zh: 他在电脑键盘上打字很快。

examples.en: Some mushrooms contain a deadly poison.
examples.zh: 有些蘑菇含有致命的毒素。

examples.en: Her grandfather was a loyal communist.
examples.zh: 她的祖父是一名忠诚的共产党员。

examples.en: The tenant pays his rent on the first of each month.
examples.zh: 这位房客每月一号交房租。

examples.en: She was furious when she saw the broken vase.
examples.zh: 看到摔碎的花瓶时，她勃然大怒。

examples.en: He is undoubtedly the best player on the team.
examples.zh: 他无疑是队里最好的球员。

examples.en: We walked along a narrow, rocky path.
examples.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄多石的小路行走。

examples.en: Do not omit any important details in your report.
examples.zh: 在报告中不要遗漏任何重要细节。

examples.en: The king was a fair and wise ruler.
examples.zh: 这位国王是个公正而明智的统治者。

examples.en: He came from an old noble family.
examples.zh: 他出身于一个古老的贵族家庭。

examples.en: A spider spun a web in the corner.
examples.zh: 一只蜘蛛在角落里织了一张网。

examples.en: His obsession with games hurt his grades.
examples.zh: 他对游戏的痴迷影响了他的成绩。

examples.en: The police found a corpse near the river.
examples.zh: 警察在河边发现了一具尸体。

examples.en: No one can say with certainty what will happen.
examples.zh: 没有人能确定地说出会发生什么。

examples.en: His plan seems problematic and hard to follow.
examples.zh: 他的计划看起来有问题，很难执行。

examples.en: Her clothes were still damp from the rain.
examples.zh: 她的衣服被雨淋得还是潮湿的。

examples.en: Fresh vegetables provide good nutrition.
examples.zh: 新鲜蔬菜能提供良好的营养。

examples.en: Reading books helps you build a larger vocabulary.
examples.zh: 读书有助于你扩大词汇量。

examples.en: The song has a beautiful and gentle melody.
examples.zh: 这首歌有着优美而轻柔的旋律。

examples.en: An electron carries a negative charge.
examples.zh: 电子带负电荷。

examples.en: The famous physicist explained how light travels.
examples.zh: 这位著名的物理学家解释了光是如何传播的。

examples.en: This warm sweater is made of pure wool.
examples.zh: 这件温暖的毛衣是纯羊毛做的。

examples.en: I was utterly exhausted after the long walk.
examples.zh: 走了那么长的路，我完全筋疲力尽了。

examples.en: The maple leaves turn bright red in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天枫叶变成了鲜艳的红色。

examples.en: She wrote a memoir about her years abroad.
examples.zh: 她写了一本关于自己在国外岁月的回忆录。

examples.en: The salesman showed us several new phones.
examples.zh: 那位推销员给我们展示了几款新手机。

examples.en: Farmers cultivate rice in these fields.
examples.zh: 农民在这些田里种植水稻。

examples.en: A daily massage is a luxury few can afford.
examples.zh: 每天按摩是很少人能负担得起的奢侈。

examples.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear.
examples.zh: 请对着麦克风讲话，好让大家都能听见。

examples.en: She waved goodbye as the train left.
examples.zh: 火车开走时，她挥手告别。

examples.en: The realization that he was wrong came too late.
examples.zh: 他意识到自己错了，但已经太迟了。

examples.en: All our tools are at your disposal.
examples.zh: 我们所有的工具都任你使用。

examples.en: The cows grazed quietly in the green meadow.
examples.zh: 牛群在绿色的草地上安静地吃草。

examples.en: She picked a ripe cherry from the tree.
examples.zh: 她从树上摘下一颗熟透的樱桃。

examples.en: The brave girl chose to defy the unfair rule.
examples.zh: 这个勇敢的女孩选择反抗那条不公平的规定。

examples.en: The forest looked magical under the moonlight.
examples.zh: 月光下，这片森林看起来充满魔力。

examples.en: Push the plug into the socket to start the fan.
examples.zh: 把插头插入插座以启动风扇。

examples.en: He keeps his cards and money in his wallet.
examples.zh: 他把卡和钱放在钱包里。

examples.en: The weather changed, so we adjusted our plans accordingly.
examples.zh: 天气变了，所以我们相应地调整了计划。

examples.en: A little lamb followed its mother across the field.
examples.zh: 一只小羊羔跟着母亲穿过田野。

examples.en: He joined a socialist party in his youth.
examples.zh: 他年轻时加入了一个社会主义政党。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread can tempt anyone.
examples.zh: 新鲜面包的香味能诱惑任何人。

examples.en: The two ideas are fundamentally different.
examples.zh: 这两种想法在根本上是不同的。

examples.en: She wrote the number on a scrap of paper.
examples.zh: 她把号码写在一张碎纸片上。

examples.en: The leader made a clear declaration of peace.
examples.zh: 这位领导人发表了明确的和平宣言。

examples.en: The crowd cheered wildly when the team scored.
examples.zh: 球队进球时，人群疯狂地欢呼。

examples.en: The nurse will inject the medicine into your arm.
examples.zh: 护士会把药注射到你的胳膊里。

examples.en: The Earth rotates around its axis once a day.
examples.zh: 地球每天绕着它的轴自转一圈。

examples.en: The actor received loud applause after the show.
examples.zh: 演出结束后，演员获得了热烈的掌声。

examples.en: She packed her clothes into a small suitcase.
examples.zh: 她把衣服装进了一个小手提箱里。

examples.en: Please divide the cake evenly among the children.
examples.zh: 请把蛋糕在孩子们之间平均分配。

examples.en: This car has a dual fuel system.
examples.zh: 这辆车有一套双燃料系统。

examples.en: A teacher will supervise the children during the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行期间会有一位老师照看孩子们。

examples.en: A short speech will precede the dinner.
examples.zh: 晚宴之前会有一个简短的演讲。

examples.en: A triangle has three sides and three angles.
examples.zh: 三角形有三条边和三个角。

examples.en: The soldier raised his shield to block the arrow.
examples.zh: 士兵举起盾牌挡住了箭。

examples.en: Her greatest aspiration is to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她最大的志向是成为一名医生。

examples.en: As a newcomer, she felt a little shy at first.
examples.zh: 作为新来者，她起初感到有点害羞。

examples.en: You can use honey as a substitute for sugar.
examples.zh: 你可以用蜂蜜来代替糖。

examples.en: Children should swim under adult supervision.
examples.zh: 孩子游泳应在成人的监督下进行。

examples.en: Milk is a good source of calcium.
examples.zh: 牛奶是钙的良好来源。

examples.en: Scientists study tiny particles in quantum physics.
examples.zh: 科学家在量子物理学中研究微小的粒子。

examples.en: We listed the pros and the con of the plan.
examples.zh: 我们列出了这个计划的利和弊。

examples.en: The path was covered with rough gravel.
examples.zh: 这条小路上铺满了粗糙的砂砾。

examples.en: This city is famous for its textile factories.
examples.zh: 这座城市以它的纺织厂而闻名。

examples.en: This court case set an important precedent.
examples.zh: 这起法庭案件开创了一个重要的先例。

examples.en: Strong nationalism united the people during the war.
examples.zh: 强烈的民族主义在战争期间团结了人民。

examples.en: They promised each other eternal love.
examples.zh: 他们彼此承诺永恒的爱。

examples.en: The jury heard the indictment against the suspect.
examples.zh: 陪审团听取了对嫌疑人的起诉书。

examples.en: An interpreter helped the tourists talk to the guide.
examples.zh: 一名口译员帮助游客与导游交流。

examples.en: The young calf stayed close to its mother.
examples.zh: 小牛犊紧紧地跟着它的妈妈。

examples.en: She leaves her baby at the nursery every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上把宝宝送到托儿所。

examples.en: The collision between the two cars blocked the road.
examples.zh: 两辆车的相撞堵住了道路。

examples.en: Please verify your phone number before logging in.
examples.zh: 登录前请验证你的电话号码。

examples.en: The course will encompass both history and art.
examples.zh: 这门课程将涵盖历史和艺术两方面。

examples.en: The whole clan gathered for the festival.
examples.zh: 整个家族聚在一起过节。

examples.en: The conflict was solved through careful diplomacy.
examples.zh: 这场冲突通过谨慎的外交手段得到了解决。

examples.en: Please wipe your shoes on the mat at the door.
examples.zh: 请在门口的垫子上擦擦你的鞋。

examples.en: She added a little spice to the soup.
examples.zh: 她往汤里加了一点香料。

examples.en: A small faction within the party disagreed.
examples.zh: 党内一个小派系持有不同意见。

examples.en: My grandmother is almost sixty years old.
examples.zh: 我奶奶快六十岁了。

examples.en: He fried the eggs in a hot skillet.
examples.zh: 他用一口热平底锅煎鸡蛋。

examples.en: The new project took an immense amount of work.
examples.zh: 这个新项目需要大量的工作。

examples.en: The rabbit gave a quick hop into the bushes.
examples.zh: 兔子轻快地一跳，钻进了灌木丛。

examples.en: There are thirteen students in our small class.
examples.zh: 我们的小班里有十三名学生。

examples.en: Fixing the old engine was a real bitch.
examples.zh: 修那台旧发动机真是件麻烦事。

examples.en: He felt ashamed of his rude behavior.
examples.zh: 他为自己粗鲁的行为感到羞愧。

examples.en: We watched a movie and had dinner afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们看了场电影，之后吃了晚饭。

examples.en: I prefer instrumental music while studying.
examples.zh: 学习时我更喜欢器乐音乐。

examples.en: She finished the whole project independently.
examples.zh: 她独立完成了整个项目。

examples.en: Many homes were destroyed in the aftermath of the storm.
examples.zh: 在暴风雨过后，许多房屋被毁。

examples.en: The astronaut floated slowly inside the spaceship.
examples.zh: 宇航员在飞船内缓缓地漂浮着。

examples.en: This broken umbrella is now completely useless.
examples.zh: 这把坏掉的伞现在完全没用了。

examples.en: Water is essential for plant reproduction.
examples.zh: 水对植物的繁殖至关重要。

examples.en: The bread had a hard, golden crust.
examples.zh: 这面包有一层又硬又金黄的外皮。

examples.en: She let out a gasp when she saw the surprise.
examples.zh: 看到那个惊喜时，她倒吸了一口气。

examples.en: The bride walked slowly toward the altar.
examples.zh: 新娘缓缓地走向圣坛。

examples.en: He stayed home with the flu for a week.
examples.zh: 他得了流感，在家待了一个星期。

examples.en: Take an umbrella; it might rain later.
examples.zh: 带把伞吧，待会儿可能会下雨。

examples.en: This temple has stood for over a millennium.
examples.zh: 这座寺庙已经矗立了一千多年。

examples.en: A mosquito bit me on the arm last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一只蚊子咬了我的胳膊。

examples.en: The man fell and lay unconscious on the floor.
examples.zh: 那个男人摔倒了，失去知觉地躺在地上。

examples.en: Years of friendship created a deep intimacy between them.
examples.zh: 多年的友谊让他们之间建立了深厚的亲密感。

examples.en: Her uncle became her legal guardian.
examples.zh: 她的叔叔成了她的法定监护人。

examples.en: Drivers must obey the traffic rules.
examples.zh: 司机必须遵守交通规则。

examples.en: Police had to divert traffic around the accident.
examples.zh: 警方不得不让车辆绕过事故现场。

examples.en: It was thoughtful of you to bring her flowers.
examples.zh: 你给她带花，真是体贴。

examples.en: A green vine climbed up the garden wall.
examples.zh: 一根绿色的藤蔓爬上了花园的墙。

examples.en: She moved permanently to a small seaside town.
examples.zh: 她永久地搬到了一个海边小镇。

examples.en: The pilots practiced landing in a flight simulation.
examples.zh: 飞行员在飞行模拟中练习着陆。

examples.en: The researchers explained their methodology clearly.
examples.zh: 研究人员清楚地解释了他们的方法论。

examples.en: He stayed passive and let others make decisions.
examples.zh: 他一直很被动，让别人来做决定。

examples.en: The loud alarm will awaken everyone in the house.
examples.zh: 响亮的闹钟会唤醒屋里的每个人。

examples.en: The cruel act caused public outrage.
examples.zh: 这种残忍的行为引起了公众的愤怒。

examples.en: The company held a monopoly on local power supply.
examples.zh: 这家公司垄断了当地的电力供应。

examples.en: He laughed loudly at the funny joke.
examples.zh: 他听到那个有趣的笑话大声地笑了起来。

examples.en: The nun spent her days helping the poor.
examples.zh: 这位修女把每天的时间都用来帮助穷人。

examples.en: She has a strong attachment to her old school.
examples.zh: 她对自己的母校有着深厚的感情。

examples.en: Grandma made a warm chicken broth for me.
examples.zh: 奶奶给我做了一碗暖暖的鸡汤。

examples.en: The court will summon him to appear next week.
examples.zh: 法院将传唤他下周出庭。

examples.en: The evening lecture is optional for students.
examples.zh: 晚上的讲座对学生来说是可选的。

examples.en: The miner worked deep underground all day.
examples.zh: 矿工整天在地下深处工作。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to read the poem aloud.
examples.zh: 老师让我们大声朗读这首诗。

examples.en: The children let their feet dangle off the bridge.
examples.zh: 孩子们把脚悬垂在桥边晃来晃去。

examples.en: The old man smoked a cigar after dinner.
examples.zh: 老人晚饭后抽了一支雪茄。

examples.en: A trade delegation visited the new factory.
examples.zh: 一个贸易代表团参观了这家新工厂。

examples.en: This breed of dog is friendly with children.
examples.zh: 这种品种的狗对孩子很友好。

examples.en: The quiet park is a haven from the busy city.
examples.zh: 这座安静的公园是远离繁忙城市的避风港。

examples.en: The injury limited the mobility of his right arm.
examples.zh: 这次受伤限制了他右臂的活动能力。

examples.en: She spoke with calm assurance during the interview.
examples.zh: 面试时她说话带着平静的自信。

examples.en: Stop acting like a jerk to your sister.
examples.zh: 别对你妹妹像个混蛋一样。

examples.en: An angry mob gathered outside the building.
examples.zh: 一群愤怒的暴民聚集在大楼外面。

examples.en: She began to weep at the sad news.
examples.zh: 听到这个悲伤的消息，她开始哭泣。

examples.en: The decision was made after a long consultation.
examples.zh: 这个决定是经过长时间的磋商后作出的。

examples.en: You must be an adult to buy liquor here.
examples.zh: 在这里你必须是成年人才能买酒。

examples.en: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
examples.zh: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。

examples.en: Managers are accountable for their team's results.
examples.zh: 经理要对团队的业绩负责。

examples.en: The witness will affirm that the story is true.
examples.zh: 证人将确认这个说法是真实的。

examples.en: She took a small sip of the hot tea.
examples.zh: 她小口地抿了一下热茶。

examples.en: Sadly, the old shop closed down last month.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，那家老店上个月关门了。

examples.en: The emergence of new technology changed our lives.
examples.zh: 新技术的出现改变了我们的生活。

examples.en: They have been lifelong friends since childhood.
examples.zh: 他们从小就是一辈子的朋友。

examples.en: The smell of coffee lingered in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 咖啡的香味在厨房里久久不散。

examples.en: The audience stood up to applaud the singer.
examples.zh: 观众起立为歌手鼓掌。

examples.en: The doctors worked hard to stabilize the patient.
examples.zh: 医生们努力使病人的情况稳定下来。

examples.en: He dropped a cube of ice into his glass.
examples.zh: 他往杯子里放了一块方形的冰。
